sources.title: Legacy of the Precursors - PoE2 Wiki

nodes.name: Isolde of the White Shroud
nodes.summary: Isolde of the White Shroud is a Holten-linked foe the Exile defeats in Scorched Farmlands alongside Heldra of the Black Pyre during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.

sources.locator: Quest log, 'Defeat Isolde and Heldra' ('Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.')

nodes.name: Heldra of the Black Pyre
nodes.summary: Heldra of the Black Pyre is a foe the Exile defeats in Scorched Farmlands alongside Isolde of the White Shroud during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.

sources.locator: Quest log, 'Defeat Isolde and Heldra' ('Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.')

nodes.name: Siora, Blade of the Mists
nodes.summary: Siora, Blade of the Mists is a boss the Exile defeats at the altar during the Recruit the Ezomytes interlude.

sources.locator: Quest log, 'Defeat Siora, Blade of the Mists.' (Siora: 'Darkness descends... and with it, your end!')

nodes.name: Elzarah, the Cobra Lord
nodes.summary: Elzarah, the Cobra Lord is a boss the Exile defeats in the Sel Khari Sanctuary during the Recruit the Maraketh interlude.

sources.locator: Quest log, 'Defeat Elzarah, the Cobra Lord.'

nodes.name: Vornas, the Fell Flame
nodes.summary: Vornas, the Fell Flame is a boss the Exile defeats after passing the Galai Gates during the Recruit the Maraketh interlude.

sources.locator: Quest log, 'Defeat Vornas, the Fell Flame.'

nodes.name: Rakkar, the Frozen Talon
nodes.summary: Rakkar, the Frozen Talon is a boss the Exile defeats in the Glacial Tarn on the way up Mount Kriar during the Recruit the Vaal interlude.

sources.locator: Quest log, 'Defeat Rakkar, the Frozen Talon.'

nodes.name: Stormgore
nodes.summary: Stormgore is a boss the Exile defeats in the Etched Ravine on Mount Kriar during the Recruit the Vaal interlude.

sources.locator: Quest log, 'Defeat Stormgore.'

edges.description: The arrival beat takes place in Kingsmarch, where the Exile reaches Doryani.

sources.locator: Talk to Doryani (quest log: 'You have arrived in Kingsmarch')

edges.description: Doryani is present in Kingsmarch on arrival and laments the state of the city.

sources.locator: Talk to Doryani: Doryani: 'This is it? This... is Kingsmarch? Science and civilisation must have never recovered.'

edges.description: The Hooded One is with the Exile and Doryani on arrival and comments on the Kalguurans.

sources.locator: Talk to Doryani: The Hooded One: 'Your time was different, yes, but don't discount the Kalguurans just yet. They have potential.'

edges.description: The charter deal with Alva, Rog and Makoru takes place in Kingsmarch.

sources.locator: Talk to Alva / Take the Boat Charter (Alva, Rog and Makoru all speak in Kingsmarch; Makoru: 'we only operate under the Meridian Free Traders of Kingsmarch')

edges.description: Alva introduces the Exile to Rog, the charter seller.

sources.locator: Talk to Alva: Alva: 'Ah, there you are! This is my contact Rog, a trader with a keen eye for valuable artefacts!'

edges.description: Rog sells the Boat Charter in exchange for Vaal treasure.

sources.locator: Talk to Alva: Rog, the Dealer: 'Kalguuran merchant vessels don't intentionally seek out danger... Take it to her.'

edges.description: Makoru, captain of the Aurora May, is the ship's captain the charter secures.

sources.locator: Talk to Makoru: Makoru: 'Welcome aboard. I'm Makoru. Captain of the Aurora May.'

edges.description: Kanu, first mate of the Aurora May, is part of the crew hired in this beat.

sources.locator: Talk to Makoru: Kanu: 'If you're lookin' for a ship, best speak to the boss, Makoru.'

edges.description: One of the rotating islands where a Weapon piece may be found is Isle of Kin.

sources.locator: Progression: island map and 'Precursor weapon pieces & Matiki locations' table (Isle of Kin, Volcanic Warrens)

edges.description: Shrike Island is one of the rotating islands holding a Weapon piece.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Shrike Island, Boss: Scourge of the Skies) and piece-location table

edges.description: Whakapanu Island is one of the rotating islands holding a Weapon piece.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Whakapanu Island, Singing Caverns, Boss: Diamora, Song of Death)

edges.description: Krutog, Lord of Kin is a boss the Exile fights while searching the islands for Weapon pieces.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Volcanic Warrens, Isle of Kin, Boss: Krutog, Lord of Kin)

edges.description: The Scourge of the Skies is a boss the Exile fights on Shrike Island during the piece search.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Shrike Island, Boss: Scourge of the Skies)

edges.description: Diamora, Song of Death is a boss the Exile fights in Singing Caverns during the piece search.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Singing Caverns, Whakapanu Island, Boss: Diamora, Song of Death)

edges.description: The Prisoner is a boss in Solitary Confinement, reached while searching for Weapon pieces; that area is not one of the three listed occurs_in locations.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Solitary Confinement, Abandoned Prison, Boss: The Prisoner)

edges.description: Makoru's ship carries the Exile between the islands during the piece search.

sources.locator: Explore the Islands: 'You have obtained a weapon piece. Speak to Makoru to travel to a new island.'

edges.description: Doryani is present and works to translate the Precursor script the Hooded One recognises.

sources.locator: Witness The Hooded One: Doryani: 'The first example of Precursor writing I've ever seen!'

edges.description: The Utopia quest starts with Missionary Lorandis in Kingsmarch.

sources.locator: Quest description: 'It is begun by speaking with Missionary Lorandis in Kingsmarch'

edges.description: The oath to the Saviour and the offer of Utopia both happen on Arastas.

sources.locator: Quest description: 'encourages you to journey to Arastas take an oath to The Saviour'

edges.description: Missionary Lorandis sends the Exile to Arastas to swear the oath.

sources.locator: Quest description: Missionary Lorandis begins the quest in Kingsmarch and sends the Exile to Arastas

edges.description: Servitor Marius offers the Exile membership in Utopia, and the refusal completes the quest.

sources.locator: Quest description: 'He proposes to join their Utopia or donate to their cause'; completion 'Speak with Servitor Marius'

edges.description: The fight against Torvian takes place on Arastas.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Arastas, Boss: Torvian, Hand of the Saviour)

edges.description: The fight against Benedictus takes place in the Excavation.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (The Excavation, Boss: Benedictus, First Herald of Utopia)

edges.description: The Countess leaves Benedictus to hold the Exile and retreats.

sources.locator: Confront Kanu and the First Herald: The Countess: 'First Herald... deal with them.'

edges.description: Kanu begs to be taken along and reveals the Beast is in Oriath.

sources.locator: Defeat Benedictus: Kanu: 'Please, please, please! Take me with you, please!'

edges.description: Tavakai strikes Kanu down after Kanu's confession.

sources.locator: Defeat Benedictus: Tavukai: 'Hyaaahhh!' ... 'Let the ancestors judge him.'

edges.description: Makoru witnesses Kanu's treachery during the Benedictus fight.

sources.locator: Defeat Benedictus: Makoru: 'Treason is unforgivable.'

edges.description: The reforging and seizure take place in the Excavated Site, which is within the Excavation.

sources.locator: Enter the Excavated Site: Makoru: 'These murals... They appear to depict the Weapon... and the Beast.' (wiki names 'Excavated Site'; treated as the Excavation)

edges.description: Tavakai takes the reforged Weapon for the Karui.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: Tavakai: 'Taking what is rightfully ours. The Karui will now be stronger than ever before!'

edges.description: Makoru is taken along by Tavakai when he flees.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: 'Tavakai flees, taking Makoru with him.'

edges.description: The Hooded One performs the reforging and then warns of the Weapon's Corruption.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: The Hooded One: 'This will take most of my strength... Stand back.'

edges.description: The inscription is read back in Kingsmarch.

sources.locator: Return to Kingsmarch: The Hooded One: 'There is no doubt now in my mind... The symbols declare it The instrument of the Third Edict.'

edges.description: The Weapon is reforged in the Excavated Site before the inscription is read in Kingsmarch.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon (after 'Enter the Excavated Site'): The Hooded One: 'you've done well... Stand back.' (wiki names 'Excavated Site'; treated as the Excavation)

edges.description: Doryani reacts to the inscription and asks about the Edicts.

sources.locator: Return to Kingsmarch: Doryani: 'The Third Edict? What is the meaning... of these Edicts?'

edges.description: Makoru is present for the reforging and seizure.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: Makoru: 'You fool! They need the Weapon! The world is at stake!'

edges.description: Tavakai is present for the reforging and seizes the Weapon.

sources.locator: Witness the Hooded One reforge the Weapon: Tavakai: 'Behold! The might of the Karui!'

edges.description: Tavakai's three-phase fight takes place at the Heart of the Tribe.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Heart of the Tribe, Act Boss: Tavakai, the Chieftain)

edges.description: The Heart of the Tribe lies within the Ngakanu area.

sources.locator: Progression: island map (Ngakanu, with Heart of the Tribe below it)

edges.description: Tavakai is the boss the Exile defeats in this beat.

sources.locator: Defeat Tavakai: Tavakai: 'I must be stronger... For the Karui!'; Phase 3: 'The power of the Ancestors is mine!'

edges.description: Tukohama, the Karui god of war, rejects Tavakai's appeal during the fight.

sources.locator: Defeat Tavakai: Tukohama: 'This... is not the Way.'

edges.description: The cure follows Tavakai's defeat, and the location is inferred from that fight.

sources.locator: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru (the quest log does not name a place; placed where Tavakai was defeated)

edges.description: The Hooded One, called Sin in the quest log, uses the Weapon to cure Tavakai and Makoru.

sources.locator: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru: The Hooded One: 'I believe so... But we have to move quickly. You must relinquish the Weapon.'

edges.description: Tavakai is cured of Blood Fever and pledges the Karui to the coming war.

sources.locator: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru: Tavakai: 'Forgive me... daughter. The fever took hold, and I... I lost my way.'

edges.description: Makoru is cured of Blood Fever alongside Tavakai.

sources.locator: Witness Sin cure Tavakai and Makoru: Makoru: 'Father!'

edges.description: The alliance plan is made in Kingsmarch.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One (after Return to Kingsmarch): 'Now, we need allies... before we assault Oriath.'

edges.description: The Hooded One decides to call the allies to war before the assault on Oriath.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: 'Now, we need allies... We should call upon the Ezomytes and the Maraketh.'

edges.description: Doryani offers his reserve forces to the alliance.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: Doryani: 'As it so happens, I may... also have some forces in reserve.'

edges.description: The Karui are already part of the alliance when the plan is made.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: 'The Karui are already with us.'

edges.description: The Ezomytes are named as the first allies the Hooded One plans to call.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: 'We should call upon the Ezomytes and the Maraketh.'

edges.description: The Maraketh are named as allies the Hooded One plans to call.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: 'We should call upon the Ezomytes and the Maraketh.'

edges.description: The Ezomyte recruitment begins and Renly is met in Ogham.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: 'To Ogham, then.'; Speak to Renly

edges.description: The bosses Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth are fought in Holten.

sources.locator: Speak to Renly: Renly: 'Our neighbours... in Holten. Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth have lost their bloody minds.'

edges.description: The Hooded One starts the quest by sending the Exile to Ogham.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: 'To Ogham, then. Hopefully, they've had time to rebuild.'

edges.description: Renly asks for the Ezomytes' help and later pledges them to the war.

sources.locator: Speak to Renly: Renly: 'It's good you're here. Our will to survive is being tested, yet again.'

edges.description: Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth are the Holten bosses the Exile defeats in this quest.

sources.locator: Completion: 'Defeat Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth'; Defeat the Thane and Lady

edges.description: Isolde of the White Shroud is one of the bosses the Exile defeats in Scorched Farmlands.

sources.locator: Quest log: 'Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.'

edges.description: Heldra of the Black Pyre is defeated alongside Isolde in Scorched Farmlands.

sources.locator: Quest log: 'Defeat Isolde of the White Shroud and Heldra of the Black Pyre.'

edges.description: Siora, Blade of the Mists, is a boss the Exile defeats at the altar.

sources.locator: Quest log: 'Defeat Siora, Blade of the Mists.' Siora: 'Darkness descends... and with it, your end!'

edges.description: The Ezomyte clans are pledged to the war once Holten is cleared.

sources.locator: Return to Renly in Ogham: Renly: 'The Thanes will answer the call. The clans will all join this war.'

edges.description: The Maraketh recruitment starts with a trip to the Bazaar where Asala is found.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One to travel to the Bazaar; Speak to Asala

edges.description: The Exile searches the Khari Crossing for the tower and the Galai Gates.

sources.locator: Travel to The Khari Crossing and locate the tower of Ab Binayi; Find the Galai Gates

edges.description: The Gifting of Water is disrupted by Azmadi in Qimah and its reservoir.

sources.locator: Explore Qimah in search of the Ceremony Site; Explore Qimah Reservoir

edges.description: The Hooded One sends the Exile to the Maraketh.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: 'At this time of year, I know where to find the Ardura akhara.'

edges.description: Asala is the Sekhema who needs the First Barya returned for the Gifting of Water and later joins the war.

sources.locator: Speak to Asala: Sekhema Asala: 'Yes. We have learned this as well... The sel khari... have not arrived.'

edges.description: Zarka reveals the location of the sel khari to the Exile.

sources.locator: Speak to Zarka: Zarka: 'Ascend the tower of Ab Binayi. At its height you will find a guiding seal.'

edges.description: Jado, of the Order of the Djinn, helps the Exile recover the First Barya.

sources.locator: Speak to Asala: Jado: 'I infiltrated the sel khari to protect the First Barya.'

edges.description: Elzarah, the Cobra Lord, is a boss the Exile defeats in the sel khari sanctuary.

sources.locator: Quest log: 'Defeat Elzarah, the Cobra Lord.'

edges.description: Vornas, the Fell Flame, is a boss the Exile defeats after the Galai Gates.

sources.locator: Quest log: 'Defeat Vornas, the Fell Flame.'

edges.description: Azmadi, the Faridun Prince, is a boss the Exile defeats in Qimah Reservoir.

sources.locator: Defeat Azmadi, the Faridun Prince: Azmadi: 'The Faridun shall rise!'

edges.description: The Maraketh join the alliance on completion of the quest.

sources.locator: Quest Complete: 'The Maraketh will join you in your journey to Oriath.'

edges.description: The Vaal recruitment takes place on Mount Kriar.

sources.locator: Speak to Doryani: Doryani: 'Before us stands Mount Kriar, the most isolated peak in the Azmeri Ranges.'

edges.description: The final confrontation with Zolin and Zelina takes place in the Cuachic Vault.

sources.locator: Enter the Cuachic Vault; Defeat Zolin and Zelina

edges.description: The Hooded One sends the Exile to Mount Kriar.

sources.locator: Speak to the Hooded One: 'Let us seek out Doryani's reserves... whatever they may be.'

edges.description: Doryani gives the code phrase and later appears to command the Cuachic.

sources.locator: Speak to Doryani: Doryani: 'If their discipline and loyalty endure... they will know us by a certain phrase.'

edges.description: Zolin and Zelina are bosses the Exile defeats in the Cuachic Vault.

sources.locator: Quest log: 'Defeat Zolin and Zelina.'

edges.description: Rakkar, the Frozen Talon, is a boss the Exile defeats on the way up Mount Kriar.

sources.locator: Quest log: 'Defeat Rakkar, the Frozen Talon.'

edges.description: Stormgore is a boss the Exile defeats in the Etched Ravine on Mount Kriar.

sources.locator: Quest log: 'Defeat Stormgore.'

edges.description: The Cuachic join the alliance once the Vaal are convinced.

sources.locator: Quest Complete: 'You have convinced the Vaal to aid you.'; Doryani: 'The Cuachic shall join our cause.'

edges.description: The assault on Oriath is planned in Kingsmarch.

sources.locator: Speak to Hooded One: 'Speak to Hooded One in Kingsmarch.'

edges.description: The siege ends at the Ziggurat Refuge instead of Oriath.

sources.locator: Quest Complete: 'have ended up in the Ziggurat Refuge despite your attempts to travel to Oriath'; infobox completion 'End up at the Ziggurat Refuge'

edges.description: The Hooded One proposes and plans the assault on Oriath.

sources.locator: Speak to Hooded One: 'Wraeclast has finally united... Come, let us plan our assault on Oriath.'

edges.description: Doryani presents the strategy for the assault on Oriath.

sources.locator: Speak to Hooded One: Doryani: 'I've been working on a strategy of sorts.'

edges.description: The Exile ends up at the Ziggurat Refuge, where Doryani later explains the Hooded One's condition.

sources.locator: Siege of Oriath Quest Complete: 'have ended up in the Ziggurat Refuge despite your attempts to travel to Oriath'; Legacy of the Precursors: 'Speak to Doryani'

edges.description: Doryani explains that the Beast's Corruption holds the Hooded One in thrall.

sources.locator: Legacy of the Precursors, Speak to Doryani: Doryani: 'As we feared, the Beast's Corruption holds the Hooded One in thrall.'

edges.description: The Hooded One is found asleep and cannot be woken, held by the Beast's Corruption.

sources.locator: Check on the Hooded One (quest log) and Speak to Doryani: Doryani: 'Nothing we do can wake him.'
